title: Page search scope belongs to Filters or Global Search (to decide)
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 1. Review where the page search / Command-K component is owned for testing.
2. Compare against the Global Search project's existing cases.
expected: 1. The page-search component is agreed to belong to either the Filters test suite or the Global Search test suite, not both.
2. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (product/QA decision on which project owns page search).
notes: SCOPE case — Global Search already has 86 authored cases for this component. This case exists to force a de-duplication decision before any push. OVERLAP: this page-search / Command-K component is also covered by the Global Search project (86 cases already authored there, currently postponed). Reconcile / de-duplicate with Global Search before any TestRail push so the same component is not tested twice. UPDATE 2026-07-29: the ENGINEERING answer is now on record (tech plan G8/D22) - the page-local toolbar search (spec v1.3 Story 13) belongs to the Filters programme; the spotlight/command-K palette is the separate Global Search v2 project with its own PRD, and the nav search additionally STOPS filtering page lists (Story 14). Pending Branko's product ratification (PO Q6); once ratified, transfer/retire FLT-SRCH-01..08 to Global Search and keep FLT-PSRCH-01..07 here.
